mapper.select: select approve_status, count(id) from first_mile_delivery where is_deleted = false group by approve_status

SELECT approve_status AS tabFlag, count(*) AS count FROM first_mile_delivery WHERE is_deleted=FALSE
GROUP BY approve_status

SELECT fd.code, fdd.id, fdd.main_id, fdd.sku_id, fdd.sku_no, fd.delivery_warehouse_id AS warehouseId, fd.delivery_warehouse_name AS warehouseName, fdd.warehouse_location, fdd.delivery_qty AS assembleQty FROM first_mile_delivery fd INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery_detail fdd ON fd.id = fdd.main_id AND fdd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fd.is_deleted = FALSE AND fdd.is_combination = TRUE
AND fd.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY fd.code DESC

SELECT pt.source_id as id, pt.id taskId, pt.code taskCode, wc.id as boxId, wc.box_no, concat(box_length, '*', wcs.box_width, '*', wcs.box_height) AS boxSize, box_length*box_width*box_height as multiplySize, wcs.package_weight, (select string_agg(concat(wcd.sku_no,'*',wcd.pack_qty), ',') from wms_carton_detail wcd where wcd.is_deleted = false and wcd.main_id = wc.id) as boxDesc, wcs.box_length as length, wcs.box_width as width, wcs.box_height as height, wcs.size_unit as sizeUnit, (select string_agg(wcd.sku_no, ',') from wms_carton_detail wcd where wcd.is_deleted = false and wcd.main_id = wc.id) as sku, (select string_agg(wcd.sku_id, ',') from wms_carton_detail wcd where wcd.is_deleted = false and wcd.main_id = wc.id) as skuIds, (select string_agg(concat(wcd.sku_no,':',wcd.sku_id), ',') from wms_carton_detail wcd where wcd.is_deleted = false and wcd.main_id = wc.id) as skuMapping FROM packing_task pt INNER JOIN wms_carton wc ON pt.id = wc.packing_task_id AND wc.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN wms_carton_spec wcs ON wc.spec_id = wcs.id AND wcs.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pt.source_id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY CAST(wc.box_no AS INTEGER)

SELECT DISTINCT fd.id, pt.packing_status, fd.code, CAST(wc.box_no AS INTEGER) AS box_no, concat(wcs.box_length, '*', wcs.box_width, '*', wcs.box_height) AS boxSize, wcs.package_weight, (select string_agg(concat(wcd.sku_no,'*',wcd.pack_qty), ',') from wms_carton_detail wcd where wcd.is_deleted = false and wcd.main_id = wc.id) as boxDesc FROM first_mile_delivery_detail fdd LEFT JOIN first_mile_delivery fd ON fd.id = fdd.main_id AND fdd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN packing_task pt on pt.source_id = fd.id and pt.is_deleted = false left join wms_carton wc on wc.packing_task_id = pt.id and wc.is_deleted = false left join wms_carton_spec wcs on wcs.id = wc.spec_id and wcs.is_deleted = false WHERE 1 = 1
AND fd.id IN
#{id}
and fd.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY fd.code, CAST(wc.box_no AS INTEGER)

select fmd.source_id as sourceId, fmd.source_code as sourceCode, fmd.source_type as sourceType, fmd.id as outstockId, fmd.code as outstockCode, fmd.shop_id as shopId, fmd.shop_name as shopName, fmd.approve_time as approveTime, fmd.delivery_warehouse_id as fromWarehouseId, fmd.delivery_warehouse_name as fromWarehouseName, fw.address as fromAddress, fmd.dest_warehouse_name as toWarehouseName, fmd.country_name as toCountryName, fmd.country_id as toCountry, tw.address as toAddress, fmd.remark from first_mile_delivery fmd left join packing_task pt on fmd.id = pt.source_id and pt.is_deleted = false left join warehouse fw on fmd.delivery_warehouse_id = fw.id and fw.is_deleted =false left join warehouse tw on fmd.dest_warehouse_id = tw.id and tw.is_deleted = false where fmd.is_deleted = false
AND (pt.packing_status = #{params.packingStatus} or fmd.approve_status = 'approve')
AND fmd.logistics_status = #{params.logisticsStatus}
AND fmd.id IN
#{id}
AND fmd.code ILIKE concat('%', #{params.searchKey}::text ,'%')
limit 20

select fmd.* from first_mile_delivery fmd left join warehouse fw on fmd.delivery_warehouse_id = fw.id and fw.is_deleted =false left join warehouse tw on fmd.dest_warehouse_id = tw.id and tw.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and fmd.is_deleted = false
